title: Senior Woman Holding Dog, Two Men in Suits - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white outdoor snapshot photograph dated November 1957, showing a smiling older woman holding a small pet dog, flanked by two young men in tailored suits and neckties. The woman wears cat-eye eyeglasses, a necklace, and a dark mid-century dress with decorative neckline detailing. The young men, likely her sons or grandsons, stand formally beside her against a backdrop of leafy foliage and a brick wall. The scalloped-edge photo features a photofinisher stamp in the right margin reading 'NOV 57'.
